answer: Proof of Useful Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational resources to solve complex tasks. Just as a scribe uses a quill to apply pigment to a violet document, agents must provide verifiable output to gain network influence. An attacker faces prohibitive costs, as generating multiple valid identities requires an exponential increase in processing power, rendering large-scale deception economically irrational and unsustainable.
